text:
Sam: Quick ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repro/pull/2446. Small identifier rename (kvCache -> kv_cache) + formatting. trying to get it into Friday's merge queue, can someone quick-check?
Maya: taking a look. can you run `gofmt -s -w` and `goimports`? CI usually complains about import grouping.
Sam: yep running now. will push the formatted changes.
ci-bot: PR #2446 — check failed: golangci-lint — goimports: imports not grouped in kvcache/manager.go
Cheng: quick question — why the rename from `kvCache` to `kv_cache`? we usually keep camelCase for vars in this package.
Sam: it's to avoid a name collision introduced when tests moved into the package namespace. the old name caused shadowing in TestManager; renaming the implementation felt cleaner than touching several tests, but i did update tests too.
Maya: if it's just test collision, changing the test var is less invasive. both ok though. can you add a comment explaining the intent so future us doesn't revert it?
Sam: good call — added a short comment + why in commit. also ran `gofumpt` and `goimports`.
Maya: paste the commands you ran so I can replicate?
Sam: sure:
```
# from repo root
gofmt -s -w ./kvcache
gofumpt -w ./kvcache
goimports -w ./kvcache
```
Maya: thanks. that should satisfy format checks.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered by Sam (push): golangci-lint — still failing: test_long_input.go: line too long (golangci-lint: revive/line-length)
Lena: the long string in test is fine for readability but our linter enforces line limits. could you wrap it or extract to a helper const?
Sam: split the long literal into two concatenated strings and added a helper const, pushed.
Maya: LGTM. two approvals needed. Cheng, can you give a quick look?
Cheng: looked through the diff. comment and helper make the intent clear. small style nit resolved. approves.
Maya: approved. Sam, do you want this merged now or wait for the Friday merge window (4pm PT)?
Sam: waiting for Friday window to batch with a couple of tiny refactors. will merge after nightly e2e passes. thanks everyone :tada: 
ci-bot: Merge guard status — approvals: 2/2, e2e: queued. Merge will be allowed when e2e passes and window opens.
